graph_diagnosis.summary: Segment evidence links cloud, retail, and services performance to consolidated revenue.
weaknesses: Most evidence was reported after the forecast cutoff.
The graph uses analyst expectations as an indirect target proxy.

search_factors.why_search: It can constrain cloud growth and margins.
Cloud performance can materially support consolidated revenue.
Retail scale can drag consolidated growth when demand is flat.
Service growth can offset retail weakness.

checkpoints.mechanism: Customer caution can slow cloud usage growth and compress margins.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Management commentary on customer spending and cloud margins.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Usage and margins accelerate despite optimization.

checkpoints.mechanism: Cost-management support can retain workloads during customer optimization.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Evidence of customer-support actions and retained demand.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Support actions coincide with falling workloads.

checkpoints.mechanism: Flat retail sales limit the contribution of the largest commerce segment.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Reported or leading retail sales growth.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Retail demand broadens and growth improves.

checkpoints.mechanism: Faster service revenue can offset weak retail performance.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Segment growth across advertising and seller services.

checkpoints.mechanism: Cloud and services gains must outweigh retail drag to shift consolidated growth momentum.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Consolidated revenue with segment growth decomposition.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Large segments weaken together or offsets are immaterial.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Optimization pressure can be mitigated when retained cloud demand supports consolidated revenue.
Service growth can offset retail weakness when their combined contribution is material.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Retail demand recovery becomes the principal driver of consolidated momentum.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Retail growth improves while services remain stable.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Cloud optimization causes broader cloud weakness despite support actions.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Cloud growth and margins deteriorate together.

forecast_audit_questions: Are segment results available before the forecast cutoff?
Do cloud and services gains exceed the retail drag?
Is the consolidated comparison based on sequential growth momentum?
